criteria.text: split_bill(1000, 3) returns three ints summing to 1000, e.g. [334, 333, 333]
for every total from 0 to 500 and n from 1 to 7, the parts sum to the total and differ by at most 1
split_bill uses integer arithmetic only (no float, no true division), so its result does not depend on the machine it runs on
